zh: n 最多 5000，每一轮长度减一，总共的加法次数约为 n²/2，直接模拟就足够快。
每一轮用相邻两项之和模 10 生成新的一层。可以原地覆盖：把第 i 项改成 (a[i]+a[i+1]) mod 10，然后把有效长度减一。
重复到只剩两个元素为止，把这两个数字直接拼成两个字符输出；第一个数字是 0 时也要原样输出，不能当成整数打印。
en: n is at most 5000 and each round shortens the array by one, so there are about n^2/2 additions in total; a direct simulation is fast enough.
Each round builds the next layer from the sums of adjacent pairs modulo 10. You can do it in place: replace a[i] with (a[i] + a[i+1]) mod 10 and then shrink the active length by one.
Repeat until two elements remain and print those two digits as a two-character string; if the first digit is 0 it must still be printed, so do not print the pair as an integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute the adjacent sums layer by layer directly; each layer is one element shorter, and the final two digits are concatenated.

## Proof of Correctness

One transformation builds the next layer strictly from the adjacent items of the previous layer; after repeating it n−2 times the length is exactly 2, so the simulation matches the definition. An independent cross-check uses the closed-form expression weighted by binomial coefficients.

## Complexity

Time O(n²), space O(n).
